views.title: Ground slab
views.desc: RC ground slab / raft (by others, engineer): main slab top -0.100 under the ICF, garage slab top -0.700; 100 insulation and screed to the ground-floor FFL 0.000 (garage -0.600).

views.title: Ground floor walls, windows, doors and partitions
views.desc: Ground-floor walls on the slab: Nudura 8in Standard external walls and the monolithic internal load-bearing walls, with the stack joints. The garage steps down to -0.700 (walls to +2.400); the rear box rises to its +4.015 parapet; the outdoor-kitchen walls run +0.750 to +3.950. Alu-clad windows and glazed doors (RAL 7016), the sectional garage door, the 120 masonry partitions and the RC dog-leg stair (all by others, indicative).

views.title: Second floor slab and the single-storey roofs
views.desc: RC second-floor slab 200 (+3.100 to +3.300, bearing on the ICF core) with the stair void and 100 build-up to the 2F FFL +3.400; the garage roof slab (+2.200 to +2.400) and the rear box roof slab (+3.100 to +3.300) with their insulation and waterproofing, rear box parapet coping. By others / engineer.

views.title: Second floor walls, windows, doors and partitions
views.desc: Second-floor walls from +3.100: the external walls to the +6.695 parapet top, the internal load-bearing walls +3.300 to +5.586 under the roof slab, with the stack joints; windows, terrace doors and the 120 masonry partitions.

views.title: Flat roof
views.desc: RC roof slab 200 (soffit +5.585), insulation to falls and screed to +6.045, waterproofing and ballast to +6.245 inside the parapet, parapet coping at +6.695 to +6.725 (section 1-1). By others / engineer.
